summary: Uses NVIDIA Maxine Video Effects AI models to remove low-light camera noise or H264 compression artifacts from still images or movies while preserving detail.
common_gotchas: Official docs mark this TOP as Windows-only and requiring a 20/30/40/50 series NVIDIA RTX card.
The required Video Effects SDK models must be downloaded separately for the target GPU.
Do not combine this feature with ZED device workflows in one project because of TensorRT version conflicts.
Denoising supports 80x80 through 1920x1080; artifact reduction supports 160x90 through 1920x1080.
High strength can remove original detail along with noise, so expose strength as an artistic/runtime control when possible.
key_concepts: Uses NVIDIA Maxine AI models to remove low-light noise or H264 compression artifacts.
Works on still images or movies while attempting to preserve detail and crispness.
Mode chooses the noise class and Strength controls the cleanup/detail tradeoff.
Denoising and artifact-reduction engines have different supported input dimension ranges.
